_comment: Crowd-sourced crash-fix catalog. Schema: fixes[] -> {failureClass, rungId, games, _comment}. games: list of Steam/Epic appIds or ["*"] for all games. Upload/contribution side is future work — this file is the seed populated from verified community fixes.

fixes._comment: UE4/UE5 titles that expose a DX12 feature level the device Vulkan driver cannot satisfy. Force -dx11 keeps dxvk (DX11->Vulkan), verified on Lies of P, Remnant 2.
Games that call SteamAPI_Init() without being DRM-wrapped. Goldberg-style bundled steam_api replacement. Only applied to STEAM source containers (condition guard in FixLadder).
Games with WMV intro/cutscene videos that crash Wine. Renaming them with .bak suffix skips the codec path.
Steam overlay (GameOverlayRenderer64.dll) crashes or hangs on some titles. DLL override n,b disables injection.
Epic Online Services SDK crash on init. Override EOSSDK-Win64-Shipping with n,b to disable EOS at load time.
Missing or incompatible d3dcompiler_47. Native-first override (n,b) picks up the bundled copy.
